title: Indians Kick Off China Open 2026 Campaign Today
indian_angle: Unnati Hooda, MR Arjun, and Hariharan Amsakarun are the first Indian players to compete on Day 1 of the prestigious China Open.
summary: India's challenge at the China Open 2026 begins today with Unnati Hooda in women's singles and the men's doubles pair of MR Arjun and Hariharan Amsakarun taking to the courts in Shenzhen.

title: Lakshya Sen Leads Indian Charge at China Masters

title: BAI Implements New 3x15 Scoring System for Junior Domestic Tournaments
